gate.rationale: V2-WS1.1b scored 90.54 corrected; +0.5 is the smallest change worth carrying forward.

notes: v1 closed 320-pixel training (CD-03), but that was a low-rate continuation from a 224-trained VideoMAE-Base parent, which is a distribution shock rather than a verdict on resolution. This is a fresh lineage trained at 288 from the start. verified by a 3-step smoke.
one_variable: data.img_size 224 -> 288. Backbone, learning rate, schedule, batch, seed, AMP dtype and position-embedding mode unchanged from V2-WS1.1b.
purpose: Input resolution 224 to 288. Resolution is the single best-evidenced recipe lever in the STAD literature: STAR measured 140x224 to 320x512 as +4.6 AVA mAP. The token grid goes from 14x14 to 18x18, so the position table is now resampled spatially as well as temporally, using interpolation, which V2-WS1.2 established is the right mode for a pretrained encoder.
